Replace the human head, body and exposed human skin with this recognizable yellow mascot. Retain the dark-brown leather flight jacket, broad brown shearling collar, gray-green ribbed neck layer and small tan layer at the center chest. Fit the collar around a rounded chin and very short broad transition, with no long neck, pinching, floating cloth, clipping or cream bib.

Preserve the exact source-visible garment layers and their positions without adding accessories, readable text, symbols, people or panels. Keep hair and cloth fully opaque. At 42x46 the small tan and gray center-chest layers cannot be identified more precisely; retain only their visible shapes and colors without inventing a new accessory. The exterior must be truly transparent, never a white matte halo or an invented photographic/studio background.
